newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ERPM to cease operations at Benoni unit.
newsitem.headline: ERPM to cease operations at Benoni unit.

text.p: Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd's East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd (ERPM) said on Monday it had decided to cease operations at its Benoni Gold Mining Co Ltd as soon as possible due to the slide in the gold price.
"The decision was prompted by the prevailing low gold price and operating losses incurred by the company over the past two months," the company said in a statement.
It said management and labour are currently engaged in negotiations to discuss the implications of this decision.
The gold price slid to 12-year lows last Thursday on enws that the Australian central bank had sold 167 tonnes of its gold stocks over the last six months.
"It is envisaged that stocks will be run down and gold brought to account. The plant will then be placed on care and maintenance until further notice," it said.
